hypotheses.rationale: Day 9 (Wednesday) shows no 'keys at elsewhere' event, confirming it as a remote work day. This reinforces the pattern: Commute days (Tue, Thu?) have keys/laptop out early; non-commute days (Mon, Wed, Fri?) have home-based routines. The consistency across Days 3, 8, and 9 strongly supports this.

Still possible if 'elsewhere' keys on Tue/Thu are for errands, but the strict 08:30 departure and 16:00 return on both observed commute days makes a standard office commute far more likely. No new evidence supports this over the hybrid model.
